description: Check whether a mail server is listed on common email DNS blocklists (DNSBLs). For a domain, its mail (MX) IPs are checked — what matters for email reputation — falling back to the A record when there is no MX; a literal IP is checked directly. Read-only DNS queries.

target.description: IP address or domain to check, e.g. 192.0.2.1 or example.com (a domain is checked at its MX mail IPs)

name: blacklist_check
